column1: # The UI texture pack of Breath of the Wild (1.9.0 and 1.6.0: these textures have the same keys in both): the textures tools/ui_pack builds,
# with their draw scale and the options of the shape method. Left out on purpose, so the game draws its own: title art and logos,
# world-map tiles and item icons (an HD texture pack covers them), button prompts and controller pictures, soft glows and shadows.
# key<TAB>scale<TAB>options (JSON)<TAB>name and where. A key is a hash of the texture's stored bytes, its size and format; no pixels and no game files are kept here.
# scale: screen px per texel at the reference height, measured in game shots (empty: not found, the default applies).
